connector.name: three.ws Billing
connector.registryDescription: An agent's account economics - plan quotas, metered usage, invoices, receipts, and earnings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package billing-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the billing endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live three.ws API reads.

env.name: THREE_WS_SESSION
env.description: Your three.ws session token (the value of the `__Host-sid` cookie from a signed-in browser). REQUIRED — it exposes private billing data, so every account-scoped read (get_billing_summary, query_usage, export_billing_history, get_receipt, get_revenue) resolves the calling user from it and returns only your data. Only the public get_fee_info works without it. Treat like a password.
